in_marathi.name: Manya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Manya means 'desire' or 'longing'. It is derived from the root word 'man' which means 'mind'. Manya is a powerful name that symbolizes the deep longing and desire that exists within each of us for knowledge, love, and spiritual growth.
